paragraphs: From Wicklow test centre on The Murrough, move off and take the 1st right to stay on The Murrough
Continue straight as the road becomes Leitrim Place
Take the next right onto Bridge Street at the end of the road turn left into Fitzwilliam Square, keep right around the square, and continue straight onto Abbey Street
Turn left onto Marlton Road and follow it for just over a kilometre
Turn left into Marlton Grove for a pull-in and reverse practice area
Move off again, keep right through Marlton Grove, perform a U-turn where directed
Exit left back onto Marlton Road by turning right
At the end of Marlton Road turn right onto Abbey Street
1st right onto Saint Patrick's Road take the next left onto Fitzwilliam Road
1st right onto Saint Manntan's Road, and turn left into Drumkay Court for another controlled stop
Turn right, complete a U-turn on the unnamed road, and return via Drumkay Court
Turn left onto Saint Manntan's Road, then at the end of the road go left onto Saint Laurence's Road
At the next end of road turn left onto Convent Road for a short stop
Move off along Convent Road, then at the end turn left onto Bay View Road, left onto Main Street, and 1st right onto Church Street
Take the next right onto Woodenbridge Row, follow the slight right onto Bachelors Walk
Turn left onto Bridge Street and left again onto Leitrim Place
Continue straight onto The Murrough take the short left, and perform a U-turn on the unnamed road to reset for the next loop
Repeat the earlier sequence: right onto The Murrough, straight onto Leitrim Place, right onto Bridge Street, left into Fitzwilliam Square, keep right, straight onto Abbey Street
Left onto Marlton Road take the right onto Marlton Link Road
1st right into Marlton Park and follow the estate roads left, left, and left to finish
From here you are only a short drive back along Marlton Road and Abbey Street to return toward the Wicklow test centre on The Murrough
